data.short_description: Float Dirty Soda and Ice Cream, an old-fashioned ice cream parlor from Emily Baker and Chase Strange, will share the property with Battleground Butcher Bar in Greensboro. The owners also run The Daily Grind coffee shop in Burlington.

Post Oak Barbecue is planning a second Denver location near the University of Denver, expected to open in October at 1737 E. Evans Avenue, taking over the former Sawa Mediterranean space. The 3,051-square-foot restaurant will seat 100 guests with a patio and larger kitchen. It specializes in Texas-style barbecue.

Party Favors, a longtime bakery in Brookline's Coolidge Corner, announced it will close permanently, with its final day set for July 15. The owners cited the lease coming to an end. The bakery has served the community for 35 years and committed to fulfilling existing orders.

Gioia Hospitality Group is planning a new waterfront restaurant at 560 NE 34th Street in Miami's Edgewater neighborhood, scheduled to open in late 2027 or early 2028. The ~11,500-square-foot restaurant will anchor a luxury development overlooking Biscayne Bay. It will feature the group's signature steak program and fresh seafood.

data.location: Falls of Neuse Road, Raleigh, NC
data.status: set to join / preparing to open
data.short_description: Lina's Bakery & Café is set to join North Raleigh's dining scene this August, from the family behind LaGana, on Falls of Neuse Road. It will operate separately from LaGana, focusing on desserts and baked goods. It is named after Carlos Lemus Sr.'s mother and mother-in-law.

The Wynwood Event Center (WEC) is a new venue for private events, weddings, and corporate gatherings replacing Shiso at 239 NW 28th Street. An official opening date has not been announced. The Shiso culinary team will remain as a catering option.

data.status: will serve its final guests / closing
data.short_description: Shiso will serve its final restaurant guests on July 12 before transforming into the Wynwood Event Center. Run by chefs Raheem Sealy and Monika Dominguez, the restaurant earned Miami New Times Readers' Poll recognition. Its culinary team and cuisine will continue as a catering option at the new venue.

data.location: 15423 US Highway 27 N, Marshall (near Exit 110 / I-94)
data.status: hoping to open / now under construction
data.short_description: Long Island Cafe is opening a second location in Marshall off Exit 110 near I-94, next to Johnny's Markets at 15423 US Highway 27 N. The team is hoping to open in mid-September, with the space now under construction. The menu is expected to stay the same as its Battle Creek location.

Cheongsu, a Seoul-based Korean dessert café, is preparing to open at 144 Harvard Avenue in Allston. The menu will feature Korean desserts such as soufflé castella, mont blanc, and bingsu, alongside matcha beverages and specialty coffees. It will be the brand's second U.S. outpost.

Gateaux Pastries, a bakery in Denver's Golden Triangle neighborhood, has announced permanent closure with a last day of Aug. 29. Owner Michelle Rasul will continue scheduled wedding cakes through the end of the year. The bakery opened in 1999 and has served celebratory cakes and pastries for decades.

data.status: preparing to open / opening date not announced
data.short_description: Gordo's Cantina is preparing to open at 209 N. Park St. in Chewelah, per a Washington State Liquor and Cannabis Board license application. It is owned by Jose and Michele Gonzalez, who also run Cantarito Mexican Restaurant in Spokane. It is planned for the former El Ranchito location.

data.status: preparing to open / targeting a summer 2026 debut
data.short_description: Rec Room, an entertainment venue owned by Bryan and Sarah Ruttkay, is preparing to open at 7727 Center Blvd. SE in Snoqualmie, targeting a summer 2026 debut. It will feature multiple TVs, a Full Swing multi-sport golf simulator, and craft beers. Food service will be provided by Treehouse Kitchen.

Tavola, an Italian restaurant in Houston's Uptown neighborhood, closed its doors this week, per an announcement from The Bastion Collection. The owners did not cite a specific reason but suggested a new concept is planned for the space. Other concepts at the property, Bar Moon and Soleil, continue to operate.

data.status: preparing to open / expected to open
data.short_description: Pompette, a French-inspired restaurant and bakery from Chef Rochelle Daniel, is expected to open in mid-September at 101 N. Leroux St. in downtown Flagstaff. The all-day concept will serve breakfast, lunch, and dinner with an in-house bakery. It is one of two new concepts Daniel is opening at the location.

data.status: preparing to open / expected to open
data.short_description: Little Rich Girl, a speakeasy-style cocktail bar from Chef Rochelle Daniel, is expected to open in mid-September beneath Atria in downtown Flagstaff. Daniel plans to pair craft cocktails with an elevated late-night food menu. It is one of two new concepts opening at 101 N. Leroux St.

Drama Club, an agave-focused cocktail bar by Scofflaw Group, opened in Chicago on July 9, 2026, between Ukrainian Village and Humboldt Park. It offers affordable cocktails and one of Chicago's largest tequila and mezcal collections. The bar is 21+, walk-ins only, open Thursday to Sunday.

data.location: 4545 La Jolla Village Drive, Suite E-25, San Diego, CA 92122
data.short_description: Telefèric Barcelona opened its first San Diego location at Westfield UTC in La Jolla on July 10, its eighth U.S. location. The family-owned brand is known for tapas, pintxos, and paellas. It also features an in-house market, El Merkat, selling imported Spanish products.

data.location: 809 N Main St K12, Las Vegas, NV 89101
data.short_description: Thai Marche is expected to open in West Las Vegas at 809 N Main St K12, per a City of Las Vegas permit, sometime later this year. Darun Khanchalee is listed as managing member and confirmed the opening. The brand has no website or social media yet; a Thai concept is suspected based on the name.

data.location: The Edge retail development, Scottsdale (Address not specified)
data.short_description: De Babel is preparing to open its second Scottsdale location later this summer at The Edge retail development, serving as the Mediterranean brand's flagship. The location will feature the same customer favorites in a larger, more contemporary space. The expansion is supported by a new central kitchen and commissary.

data.status: opening / making its DC debut this fall
data.short_description: Botiwalla, a concept from the Chai Pani Restaurant Group, will open a new location in Tenleytown's Upton Place at 4000 Wisconsin Ave NW this fall. It will be the chain's DC debut; it currently has five locations in North Carolina and Atlanta. The menu features Indian street food including charcoal-cooked kababs.
